resources.string:
yt-dlp is a powerful command-line tool for downloading videos. KirinDL makes it easier to use yt-dlp by providing an intuitive GUI, presets for common commands, and other additional features.

For advanced usage of yt-dlp, KirinDL allows you to create, save and execute custom command templates directly, just like in a terminal.

When using custom commands, most of the GUI options and features would be disabled.
KirinDL is free and open source. You can support the project by reporting bugs, suggesting features, and contributing improvements.
